stem: The domain of the function $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x^{12} - x^9 + x^4 - x + 1}}$ is
solution:
For $x \le 0$ all terms are non-negative and the constant is 1, so the expression $> 0$. For $0 < x < 1$: $x^{12} + x^4(1 - x^5) + (1 - x) > 0$. For $x \ge 1$: $x^9(x^3 - 1) + x(x^3 - 1) + 1 > 0$.

Hence the expression is always positive and the domain is $(-\infty, \infty)$.
